claims.text: Severe pulmonary histoplasmosis (eg, severe dyspnea, hypoxia, ARDS): amphotericin B preferred initially, plus consider concurrent methylprednisolone (clinical benefit in severe dz).
claims.quote: In individuals with severe pulmonary histoplasmosis, eg, severe dyspnea, hypoxia, or acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), initial treatment with amphotericin B is preferred, plus consideration of concurrent methylprednisolone, which has shown clinical benefit with severe disease.
